Winning now earns you the official promo cards. Wins as a hero, against a villain or with an event open promo art you can put in place of a card's normal picture, and the wins already in your save count. Every release now has its own place on the site, Settings has a search, and Install for Steam is one script that keeps the game up to date from inside the game. Cards left lists the villain's stages, 21 cards that showed the wrong scan show their own, and Kang's stage 3 plays the way it's printed.

Earn the promos

Issue #192 by @PermaKarma · PR #561

Extras has a new Promos tab. A locked promo shows its art in the hover and how far along you are, like "2/3: Win 3 games as Spider-Man (Peter Parker)". An open one has Use this art, and the picture changes everywhere the card is drawn. It's art only, so the rules never change.

How you earn one

  • A hero's first printing: 3 wins as that hero.
  • A hero's second printing: 10 wins as that hero.
  • A villain or team: 3 wins against its scenario.
  • An event: 3 wins with it in your deck, reprints counted together.
  • The wins you already have count. Progress comes from your save history, so you may open Extras and find some waiting. Tutorial wins don't count.

Good to know

  • A card shows one printing at a time, and your choice follows your save and device sync.
  • Turn them all off with Promo card art in Settings ▸ More ▸ Earned items. Unlock everything opens them all.
  • A promo shows the text it was printed with. The game plays the current text.
  • There are no Spanish promo scans, so a Spanish build shows them in English.

Choose your hero tiles, too. A button beside Use preconstructed steps through Game art, Card art, and Promo art once you've earned one. It's also the Hero art row in Settings ▸ Cards.

Every release, in one place

Issue #588 · PR #589

The Release notes link on the Title opens a release history, and you may be reading this report inside it. Pick any release and it swaps in without a reload, with its announcement on top and its release notes under it. Releases that never had an announcement get one written from their notes.

Getting around

  • Every release reads in English or Spanish. The toggle at the top of the page swaps it, and it opens in the language your game uses.
  • It lists the last 10 releases, and Show older releases opens the rest, back to v0.1.0.
  • Every release has its own link, and the browser's back button works at every step.
  • Phones and tablets get a bar with ‹ and › for the next release along.
  • On a controller: the D-pad moves, the face button opens, LB and RB go newer and older, and a stick scrolls.

Search Settings

Issue #576 · PR #578

Press the magnifier in the Settings title bar and type. It finds every setting, and anything on the pages under it: Rules, Unlocks and How it works, Save data, Controls, Your stats and How to play. The best match comes first, with the matched words marked, and a press takes you straight there.

  • Each result says where it lives, and backing out of a page returns you to the search.
  • On a controller, Y opens and shuts it, and LB and RB page the results.
  • On a keyboard, PageUp, PageDown, Home and End get around the results.
  • On a phone the field stays at the top, so the keyboard only ever covers the results.

One Steam script, for good

Issue #582 · PR #583 · follows #422 and #423

Install for Steam is now one script for each system, with a link that never changes. It finds the latest release itself, and on Windows and macOS it no longer needs the game installed first. On Linux there's a .tar.gz, so the script stays executable after a browser download.

Updates from inside the game

  • It works in Game Mode. The script runs with no terminal and its progress shows in a panel, which a controller can reach.
  • It downloads first. Then pick Quit and install, or Keep playing and it installs when you next quit.
  • The Title footer and bug reports say "Steam script", and Settings ▸ More ▸ Steam install opens the panel.
  • If it fails it says why, and offers the download.

Run it once, then tell me how it went

If you installed with an older script, run the new one once. That's what lets the game find it. Every link is on the downloads page ↗.

This is new, and I can't test every setup here, a Mac least of all. If it goes wrong on your Deck, PC or Mac, tell me from Pause ▸ Report a problem or on GitHub.

Cards left knows the villain

Issue #575 · PR #577

The encounter deck's list now starts with the villain's stages, as cards with the hover and Inspect. The stage up has an In play chip, the ones ahead follow it, and beaten stages drop off.

No spoilers you didn't ask for

  • Stages sit behind Encounter deck's cards left, since they can name one you haven't met.
  • It lists this game's faces: standard Hela shows A1 and A2, and expert shows B1 and B2.
  • A villain still set aside isn't listed.

Settings apply at once

A setting changed from Pause now reaches the table when you go back, without a reload. Turning on cards left used to do nothing until the game next changed. Every setting the table draws is covered.

Everyone's numbers, easier to find

Issue #563 · PR #565

The You / Everyone switch now sits at the top of Your stats on every tab, and it shows in the deck builder even with no games of your own. It reads "You / All" on a phone.

Sharing, from the stats page

  • Share my games turns sharing on with one press, with a line saying what is sent. Games you've already finished are never sent.
  • The Title still only asks once, and turning sharing off stays in Settings.
  • An empty Everyone says a row needs 20 shared games, with the count so far.
  • Choosing Everyone shows only Heroes, Villains and Encounter, and You takes you back.

Back to the printed card

PR #566

Checking the cards that had the wrong scan turned up two script bugs. The printed numbers and text were right; the way they played wasn't.

Kang

The Once and Future Kang

Completing a stage 3 now removes that Kang (II) and the stage at the end of the phase. Before, he could follow the players and sit beside Kang (III).

All 4 copies of Kang's Dominion start set aside, as stage 1A says, and each completed stage tucks exactly 1 under stage 4A. Players join only once when a Kang (II) is defeated in the phase its stage was completed.

Printed cards · the single join is an engine reading, as no ruling covers it
The Wrecking Crew

Escaped Convict's boost

All four copies now make no attack on an ordinary scheme. The one exception is a scheme a boost started during an attack, like I've Been Waiting For This!, where the new attack follows that scheme.

A saved game may not carry over: a Kang game past a stage 3, or a Wrecking Crew game where this came up, can replay differently and be marked incompatible.

FFG ruling, May 16, 2024 · RRG 1.8 p. 6

You asked, we fixed

Issues #568 · #569 · #571 · #572
#572 · reported by @PermaKarma

Wounded Hela has her card

Hela's A2 and B2 faces never had a scan, so the table drew a generated frame. Both now show the real card, and Expert Hela B1 and The Wastes of Niffleheim use new scans.

#569 · reported by @PermaKarma

Paying for Team-Building Exercise

One tile per card Organizational Support can exhaust, where the sheet used to draw one identical tile per set of cards. Confirm stays off, reading "Pay N more", until the payment pays. Picking a card from your own hand no longer stops Undo.

#571 · reported by @PermaKarma

Which Field Agent was that?

Decision sheets now show the counters each card in play holds, so two copies of a Uses card can be told apart. The "If you confirm" line reads Field Agent's Hero Interrupt, not a Uses line that always said 3.

#568 · reported by @Vasko47

Cloak of Levitation, under Unnatural Storm

A player card ability that only readies a card is no longer offered while that card can't ready, so the Cloak isn't spent for nothing. Ready to Rumble, Battle Fury and Justice Served had the same bug.

RRG 1.8 p. 14, p. 24, p. 43 · FFG ruling on Unnatural Storm

Every card on its own scan

PR #560 · PR #574

Art matching can't tell near-identical cards apart, so some of my scans landed on a neighbouring stage, side or set. I placed these by folder, name, stage and side instead, and 21 cards now show their own.

  • Wrong card, now right: Green Goblin III, Mojo II, Spiral II, Enchantress I, Piledriver B, Expert Kang I, Black Widow III, Batroc B, A.I.M. Interference (mental) and more.
  • Older images replaced: Green Goblin, The Wrecking Crew, Kang, The Hood, MojoMania, Trickster Takeover and Synthezoid Smackdown, plus the Standard PvP faces.
  • Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Black Widow II, Batroc A, Baron Zemo's other three faces and the other A.I.M. Interference cards use my scans.

Taskmaster gets his face back

PR #567

The stage-flip splash cropped Taskmaster at the chest. He and twelve other villains now keep their faces. A lost issue's Rewind shows the villain's own picture too, not a comic panel.

Fixed along the way

PR #580 · #581 · #584 · #586
#579

The whole top row, by pad

A controller and the keyboard now reach the theme and language buttons on the title menu. A focused top button and Read more show the button to press.

#587

Red rank bars

Rank progress bars fill Hero Red in light and dark mode. Dark mode's bar tracks, the deck cost chart and the opening-hand scroller stay readable too.

#585

Sync keeps up with a long game

Steady play could hit the server's hourly cap, and then pushes were refused for up to an hour. A game now pushes after each round, when you leave it and when it sits idle, under that cap.

A desktop window regaining focus pulls too. Offline play hasn't changed.
